text:
liz: Quick preflight for tomorrow's customer webinar (10:00am PT). Can we lock greenroom flow + recording handoff? Need Zoom settings, RTMP fallback, captions, and HubSpot field mapping confirmed. :wave:

devin: On it. Quick checklist please — who owns post-event clips + timestamps?

maria: Marketing owns highlights + CTAs. Video team will take raw, trim to 3x 90s clips. I'll own publish notes in HubSpot.

liz: Perfect. Key items:
- Zoom: cloud recording (gallery + shared screen), record separate audio, enable closed captions, automatic transcript.
- RTMP fallback to Mux in case Zoom cloud upload stalls.
- Local backup on presenter's laptop as fail-safe.
- Greenroom: start 30m prior, host + panelist mic checks, slide advance test.

ops-bot: Deploying runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/virtual-event-preflight — includes commands and checklist.

sam: Zoom settings I will toggle. Question on captions: enable Zoom auto-captions OR rely on Otter post-processing? Auto-captions are messy but immediate.

alisha: Recommend auto-captions ON for accessibility + Otter for cleaner post-event transcript. We'll tag both in the asset metadata.

devin: HubSpot mapping — please confirm fields. Proposed mapping:
```
email -> contact.email
first_name -> contact.firstname
last_name -> contact.lastname
company -> company.name
utm_source -> marketing.utm_source
webinar_id -> marketing.webinar_id
consent -> marketing.opt_in
```
Can we also add a "tier" field if attendee is enterprise?

maria: Add tier -> contact.lead_tier (optional). Also we need to route high-value leads (company revenue > $1M OR job_title matches Senior/Head/VP) to sales-sdr-live queue immediately.

sam: For routing, I'll add this rule in HubSpot workflows: if company.revenue > 1000000 OR title contains (Head|VP|Director|Sr\.) -> assign to sales-sdr-live and send slack alert to #sales.

liz: Post-event cadence: 45m follow-up (thanks + recording), 24hr nurture (top 3 clips + CTA), 7-day trial invite if not converted. Can marketing ops draft the 45m email?

maria: Drafting now. Who's doing the 45m send? We should use the webinar send IP (warm) not transactional.

devin: I'll schedule send from marketing-email@redwood.com, include SSO link and TTL for asset (replay expires in 90 days).

video-team: We'll capture separate tracks, generate native captions, and export 3 highlight clips by EOD tomorrow. Please flag timestamps in the doc during the live event for quicker edit.

alisha: I'll be in greenroom to mark key moments and push timestamps to the shared doc. Also will monitor registrant surge. If signups > 150/hour, switch lead routing to "surge" where SDRs get a daily digest + top 20 live alerts.

liz: Ops items for Sam: confirm RTMP credentials (Mux), enable cloud recording + local backup instructions for host, toggle auto-captions. Maria: finalize HubSpot field mapping and routing rules. Video-team: prepare export templates.

sam: Will do. RTMP creds: will DM to ops and put encrypted creds in 1Password.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: greenroom 30m before (09:30 PT).

liz: Thanks team. Last ask — can someone post a 1-sentence social copy for live announcement after the greenroom? I'll adapt and post. :white_check_mark:
